missions.title: Trust kept
missions.button: Idris wants to hear about your road

text: Idris pours tea and listens while you tell him about Jisra, Sahila and Sukara - all of it, the parts you are proud of and the parts you are not.
“Trust is not a gate you pass once,” he says. “It is a road you keep walking. The north gate is the Gate of Patience. The caravanserai at Safira needs someone who can wait.”

b.text: The next morning the gatekeepers at the north gate open it for you.
